title: RBI Deposit Rates and Bulk Deposit Disclosure Amendment Directions
description: <cite index="42-3">RBI's July 30, 2026 Amendment Directions tighten bulk-deposit rate disclosure timing (by 10:10 am daily) and mandate uniform pricing across branches for Commercial, Small Finance, RRB, Payments, Local Area and Urban Co-operative Banks</cite>, effective October 1, 2026.
